title: Part 2: realistic mixed group — liars + mistaken + regular + specialist

notes: 8 agents, all blind IDs, four different roles:
analyst_1-2: informed liars (know right answer, argue wrong)
analyst_3-4: mistaken agents (leaning wrong but convincible)
Tests: do liars recruit the mistaken agents? Do specialists protect the regulars?
Most realistic scenario — a real group has a mix of intentions and competence.
